you've recently signed up to this practice, but feel hesitant to contact them due to the overwhelmingly negative reviews - please don't let that prevent you from seeking help from this practice.

You should keep in mind that people are more inclined to leave a negative review than a positive one. The amount of negative feedback is most likely disproportionate to the overall feedback were people more willing to leave positive feedback.

I've been with this practice for about 2.5 years. I've had to contact them a handful of times. EACH interaction has been courteous and well handled, be it reception, nurse or GP. They are all working hard to serve the local community.

Also, give the receptionists a chance. The sheer amount of unpleasantness they have to deal with from 8 AM to closure is mindboggling and would send most of us home in tears. Treat them with respect and they'll cross oceans for you. Also - them asking why you're calling... that's their literal job. Their job is to ensure you see the right individual, hence why they ask why you're calling. Answering them with "well, what's that to you?" in a snarky tone is not going to go the way you want it.
